items.title: Mozambique: President calls for early action to mitigate effects of El Niño
items.summary: Mozambique’s president called on Monday for early action to mitigate the impacts of El Niño, which is approaching at an “accelerated and alarming” rate, and urged new ways of funding food security in one of the countries most affected by disasters.
